title: ResQMeshEvent
description: Standard idempotent event packet for distributed peer-to-peer synchronization

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for the event record used for duplicate suppression

event_type.description: Domain type of the disaster response event

origin_node_id.description: Unique cryptographic identifier of the originating peer node

device_clock.description: Monotonic logical clock counter for Last-Writer-Wins consensus

hop_count.description: Current number of hops traversed across the mesh

signature.description: Ed25519 digital signature of origin node
